policy.rule: Do not copy proprietary logos, videos, UI kits, or campaign assets into this repository unless the license explicitly permits redistribution.
policy.use: Use this file as an index for study, design inspiration, and compliance-aware references.

companies.name: Apple
do_not: redistribute Apple templates or brand assets without checking license and usage rules

companies.name: Google Material Design
do_not: treat Google trademarks or product icons as reusable brand assets

companies.name: Google Brand Resource Center
do_not: use Google logos without permission or partnership approval

companies.name: Microsoft
do_not: copy Microsoft logos, icons, or product marks into project assets without following the trademark rules

companies.name: Microsoft Fluent
do_not: claim the project is Fluent unless actually implemented with Fluent components

companies.name: YouTube
do_not: use YouTube marks in promotional materials outside the published guidelines

companies.name: OpenAI
usable_for: OpenAI and ChatGPT trademark usage boundaries
do_not: use OpenAI marks as if this project is endorsed by OpenAI

companies.name: Anthropic
do_not: download or reuse unofficial Anthropic logo packs as project assets

companies.name: Gemini
do_not: assume this applies to Google Gemini AI branding without checking the exact source
